beats.label: S1 · Plane goes down
beats.text: The Yellowjackets' plane crashes en route to Nationals, stranding survivors deep in the wilderness. Misty secretly destroys the emergency beacon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the survival premise and Misty's first act of sabotage, which locks the entire series-long isolation into place.

beats.label: S1 · Cabin and rifle
beats.text: The survivors find an abandoned cabin with a rifle and a dead occupant in the attic. Natalie and Travis emerge as the group's hunters.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the setting for everything that follows and the hunter/spiritual power structure the group will fight over for two more seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Shauna's secret
beats.text: Shauna confesses to Taissa that she is pregnant with Jeff, her best friend Jackie's boyfriend, whom she slept with the night before the crash.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up both the pregnancy that drives S2's central storyline and the Jackie/Shauna rupture that ends S1.

beats.label: S1 · Lottie's visions
beats.text: Off her schizophrenia medication, Lottie's visions grow stronger and she gathers followers, including Van and eventually Travis.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the wilderness mysticism that will drive every group decision in S2 and structure Lottie's adult cult in the present.

beats.label: S1 · Doomcoming
beats.text: The team unknowingly eats hallucinogenic mushrooms at Doomcoming and hunts Travis; Lottie orders Shauna to slit his throat but Natalie stops her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The first time the group crosses into ritual violence — the template for every wilderness sacrifice that follows.

beats.label: S1 · Jackie freezes
beats.text: Jackie confronts Shauna over Jeff and is banished to sleep outside; the first snow arrives and she freezes to death by morning.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jackie's corpse becomes the object Shauna cannot let go of in S2, and the first meal the starving team is driven to eat.

beats.label: S1 · Adult fallout
beats.text: In 2021, Shauna kills Adam after learning her husband Jeff was the blackmailer, and a masked group kidnaps a newly-sober Natalie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the two present-day threads S2 opens on: the Adam cover-up and Natalie's captivity at Lottie's compound.

cliffhanger.text: Jackie's corpse sits frozen at the cabin door as winter closes in. In 2021, Adam's body has been dumped, but a masked group has just kidnapped Natalie.
questions: Who took Natalie, and what do they want from the survivors?
How will the starving group make it through winter without Jackie?
Can Shauna and her friends keep Adam's murder buried?

characters.name: Shauna Sadecki
characters.line: Yellowjackets midfielder secretly pregnant by her best friend's boyfriend; in 2021 she kills her lover Adam after discovering her husband was blackmailing her.

characters.name: Natalie Scatorccio
characters.line: The team's reluctant hunter who stops Lottie from sacrificing Travis; in 2021 she is kidnapped by a masked group on the day she gets sober.

characters.name: Lottie Matthews
characters.line: Off her schizophrenia meds, her visions have made her the wilderness's spiritual leader, with Van and Travis among her followers.

characters.name: Misty Quigley
characters.line: The team's equipment manager who secretly destroyed the emergency beacon to keep the group stranded and needing her.

characters.name: Jackie Taylor
characters.line: Team captain and Shauna's best friend; after confronting Shauna over Jeff she is banished from the cabin and freezes to death in the first snow.

characters.name: Taissa Turner
characters.line: Team co-captain and Shauna's confidant about the pregnancy, skeptical of Lottie's growing cult.

characters.name: Travis Martinez
characters.line: The coach's son and co-hunter with Natalie; hunted at Doomcoming and saved by Natalie when Lottie ordered his throat cut.

characters.name: Jeff Sadecki
characters.line: Jackie's boyfriend who slept with Shauna the night before the crash; in 2021 he is revealed as the blackmailer targeting adult Shauna.

beats.label: S2 · Eating Jackie
beats.text: Two months into winter, a starving Shauna talks to Jackie's frozen corpse; the team ends up cooking and eating her body after a botched cremation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The first act of cannibalism reframes what the group is capable of and licenses every hunt that follows.

beats.label: S2 · Javi returns
beats.text: Van and Taissa track Taissa's fugue-drawn symbols to a disoriented Javi, who has survived alone in the woods since Doomcoming.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Javi's return quietly sets up the sacrifice that ends the winter and breaks Travis for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S2 · Shauna's stillborn
beats.text: Shauna gives birth alone and the baby does not survive. Convinced the team ate him, she beats Lottie unconscious as the group looks on.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shauna's grief and rage begin the shift in her from wife-and-mother to the person who will lead the team in S3.

beats.label: S2 · The card draw
beats.text: With starvation setting in, the team draws cards to pick a sacrifice; Natalie draws the Queen of Hearts but escapes into the woods.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Formalizes the ritualized hunt system that governs every later killing, including the S2 finale and Mari's death.

beats.label: S2 · Javi drowns
beats.text: Chasing Natalie across the frozen lake, Javi falls through the ice and the team lets him drown, taking his death as the sacrifice they needed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the group will let people die rather than break the hunt, and gives Travis the grief that shapes his adult death.

beats.label: S2 · Cabin burns
beats.text: Lottie hands leadership to Natalie; that night the cabin is set on fire, leaving the survivors homeless as spring approaches.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the physical anchor of the first two seasons and sets up the S3 arson trial that convicts Ben.

beats.label: S2 · Ritual at the compound
beats.text: In the present, the women meet at Lottie's compound; a botched ritual ends with Natalie taking a fentanyl injection meant for Lottie and dying in Misty's arms.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off Natalie in the present timeline, reshaping the adult-Misty and adult-Shauna storylines that dominate S3.

cliffhanger.text: The cabin is a smoking ruin as spring nears, leaving the team without shelter under Natalie's uneasy leadership. In the present, Natalie is dead, Lottie has been committed, and the Adam investigation has been buried by framing Kevyn.
questions: Who set fire to the cabin?
Where is Coach Ben, and what will the team do to him if they find him?
What did Lottie mean when she said the wilderness is pleased and will reward them?

characters.name: Shauna Sadecki
characters.line: Talks to Jackie's frozen corpse through the winter, loses her baby alone, and beats Lottie unconscious believing the team ate him.

characters.name: Natalie Scatorccio
characters.line: Draws the Queen of Hearts in the sacrifice lottery but survives when Javi drowns instead; Lottie hands her leadership of the group. In the present she dies from a fentanyl injection meant for Lottie.

characters.name: Lottie Matthews
characters.line: Beaten by Shauna and stripped of leadership in the wilderness; in the present she runs the compound where the botched ritual kills Natalie.

characters.name: Taissa Turner
characters.line: Her sleepwalking fugue draws symbols that lead her and Van to find Javi alive in the woods.

characters.name: Misty Quigley
characters.line: Cradles a dying Natalie in her arms at Lottie's compound after the ritual goes wrong.

characters.name: Javi Martinez
characters.line: Travis's younger brother, found alive after months alone in the woods, drowns under the ice as the team lets him die for the sacrifice.

beats.label: S3 · Spring under Natalie
beats.text: By late spring, Natalie's leadership has stabilized the team, but Ben has secretly survived alone in the woods, setting traps.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's status quo and the hidden Ben whose discovery drives the middle of the season.

beats.label: S3 · Shauna and Melissa
beats.text: Shauna's rift with Mari and the team deepens after her stillborn; she begins a secret affair with JV player Melissa after Melissa finds the baby's grave.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Shauna–Melissa bond that becomes the season's central adult-timeline mystery.

beats.label: S3 · Ben on trial
beats.text: The team captures Ben, tries him for burning the cabin, and finds him guilty; Melissa slashes his Achilles so he cannot run.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Formalizes the group's descent into judicial violence and forces Natalie into the choice that costs her the leadership.

beats.label: S3 · Natalie kills Ben
beats.text: Unable to watch Ben suffer, Natalie mercy-kills him; the enraged team removes her as leader and installs Shauna in her place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The power transfer that makes Shauna the wilderness antagonist for the rest of the season and rewrites the group's dynamic.

beats.label: S3 · Scientists arrive
beats.text: Three adult scientists stumble on the camp; Lottie kills Edwin on sight and Shauna refuses to let Hannah and Kodiak leave.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brings the outside world within reach for the first time since the crash and hands Natalie the phone that ends the season.

beats.label: S3 · Adult Melissa found
beats.text: In the present, a cassette threat leads adult Shauna to Melissa, now married into Hannah's family; the confrontation ends with Melissa stabbing Van to death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the season's adult mystery, kills off Van, and drives Taissa into her final act of ritual mourning.

beats.label: S3 · The satellite phone
beats.text: Mari dies in a rigged hunt as cover for Natalie to reach a cliff with the scientists' satellite phone; a man's voice answers on the other end.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central cliffhanger — the first two-way contact with the outside world since the crash.

cliffhanger.text: A man's voice answers Natalie's satellite call as Mari's body is butchered. In the present, Van is dead, Callie has confessed to killing Lottie and fled with Jeff, and Shauna sits alone in her empty house resolving to reclaim her power.
questions: Who answered Natalie's call, and will they actually rescue the team?
Can Misty and Taissa reconcile with the leader Shauna has become?
Will Callie and Jeff ever come back, or is Shauna truly on her own?

characters.name: Shauna Sadecki
characters.line: Grieving her stillborn, she begins a secret affair with Melissa and is installed as the group's new leader after Natalie mercy-kills Ben; in the present a cassette leads her to confront Melissa, who stabs Van to death.

characters.name: Natalie Scatorccio
characters.line: Her stabilizing leadership ends when she mercy-kills Ben and the team deposes her; she reaches a cliff with the satellite phone and hears a man's voice answer.

characters.name: Melissa
characters.line: JV player who begins a secret affair with Shauna and slashes Ben's Achilles at his trial; in the present she is married into Hannah's family and stabs Van to death when confronted.

characters.name: Ben Scott
characters.line: The assistant coach who secretly survived alone in the woods setting traps; captured, tried for burning the cabin, and mercy-killed by Natalie.

characters.name: Mari
characters.line: Shauna's rival in camp whose rift deepens after the stillborn; dies in a rigged hunt staged as cover for Natalie's run to the satellite phone.

characters.name: Hannah
characters.line: One of three adult scientists who stumble on the camp; Shauna refuses to let her leave after Lottie kills her colleague Edwin.
